frontend_rtl.note: Actual qualified engine frontend RTL and physical UART waveform models. The counter is checked every simulation cycle. The clock-dots run started before the CLOCK-resume instrumentation fix, so its logged call count is not a valid count. A separate current-harness CLOCK payload probe checks the returned elapsed value and records one resume. Not a mapped-primitive or physical pass.
frontend_rtl.handshake: Capture response while the core clock is stopped, then admit its edge one full board cycle later.

flash_transport.method: 03h SPI command/address and every byte checked with read backpressure against NOR model

physical.superseded_reason: Stopped during placement refinement to add a separate response-sampling stage before the admitted core edge, matching the qualified single-command monitor. No bitstream generated or loaded.
